next_step: Re-engage post Q2 budget freeze; deliver integration kit + tracing example; propose 3-month MVP SOW
notes:
Summary: POC initially promising; stalled in procurement. Primary blockers are integration friction (no official Go SDK, incomplete Java async client), auth/SSO/KMS detail gaps, and lack of tracing/observability hooks. Security asked for OpenTelemetry tracing examples and token-level cost breakdowns.

Timeline / recent activity (bulleted):
- 2025-11-12: Intro call (AE Samantha) — high-level fit for support agent + semantic search.
- 2025-12-05: Technical deep-dive w/ infra and security (SE Diego) — asked for SAML/KMS details.
- 2026-01-08: 2-week POC started (hosted_api) — initial latency and quality checks passed.
- 2026-01-22: Security review meeting — requested ISO documentation, encryption-at-rest diagrams, and per-token retention policy.
- 2026-02-12: Demo w/ product team — engineering raised missing Go SDK and lacking OpenTelemetry hooks for Datadog/Lightstep.
- 2026-02-28: Procurement paused due to Q2 budget freeze; decision trending to NimbusAI because they already had an embedded proxy and tracing pipeline.

Quotes / Call notes: 
- "We love the throughput numbers, but if we can't get traces into our APM and a Go client that matches our stack, it's hard to justify migration." — Principal Engineer.
- "Security will not sign off without a KMS integration timeline and sample SAML SSO flow." — Head of Infra.

POC details:
- Workload: chat-first support assistant + periodic reranking for search results.
- Latency target: p95 < 300ms for short chat turns, throughput ~150 rps during peak.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high; wants per-route token cost and caching recommendations to reduce spend.
- Model preferences: open models with quantized variants; willing to test Redwood-recommended variants if tracing and auth gaps closed.

Why stalled / lost risk:
- Integration friction: no off-the-shelf Go SDK and missing async Java examples increased engineering effort estimate.
- Observability gap: customer requires OTEL-compatible hooks + example instrumentation; competitor offered a turnkey proxy that shipped traces.
- Security docs: requested ISO27001 attestation and KMS integration timeline; docs lagged from security ops.
- Economic: internal budget freeze moved timeline out of current fiscal window; competitor secured short-term credits.

Actions taken by Redwood:
- Provided SOC2 + draft ISO scope (drive doc link above).
- Eng team delivered a Python and Node quickstart; committed to Go SDK backlog item and prototype tracer sample.
- Opened support tickets RDW-4821 (KMS integration questions) and RDW-5090 (tracing example request).

Open questions / next steps (short):
- Confirm Q2 re-budgeting timeline with procurement (owner: Samantha).
- Deliver engineering integration kit (Go minimal client, OTEL example) by 2026-04-15.
- Offer 3-month MVP SOW with discounted credits to cover migration risk.

CRM tags / shorthand: stalled, closed-lost-risk, integration-friction, security-led, budget-freeze
